verdict.rationale: The only evidence that a free tier exists is a community report that quotes the 'Brave Search API free tier ToS' (comm-1). That same report says the free-tier terms prohibit using responses for AI inference, and comm-2 says AI use requires switching to a separate AI Inference plan. Free prototyping is therefore restricted for the AI/agent use cases the docs promote, and the first-party docs only say you can get an API key and make a first request quickly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the free tier or free credits (quota, rate limits, no-card signup), confirmation that free use covers AI/LLM prototyping, and hands-on corroboration of free-tier signup.
